newsitem.title: UK: Currency dominates Bradford wool market.
newsitem.headline: Currency dominates Bradford wool market.

text.p: Sterling's strength against the Australian dollar dominated the market and, as costs were calculated lower, some reductions in quotes for wool and tops applied even without wool sales to act as a guide to the world market.
Non-UK suppliers were keenly aware of their price advantage and UK producers worried that, after present orders dry up, there may be little to follow.
Textile trade was very competitive and retailers faced the temptation of paying less for imports than for home production.
